relation.rationale: The difference is the final 'e' (weis vs. weiße), which is treated as a grammatical ending variation (e added/dropped) per the instructions.
The difference between 'mahlen' (infinitive) and 'mahlem' (archaic dative singular) is a change in grammatical form (case/ending).
The difference is the use of the long s (ſ) versus the short s (s) in the word 'worüber'/'warüber'.
Jeſu is the vocative form, Jeſus is the nominative form; this is a difference in grammatical case/ending.
Difference in the vowel digraph (e/ä) within the same word form.
The readings differ between 'mit gnaden' (with grace) and 'genädig' (gracious), which are different words with different grammatical functions (prepositional phrase vs. adjective).
The readings differ in the word itself: 'gnaden' (grace) vs 'genadenliecht' (light of grace).
The words 'recht' (rightly/justly) and 'noch' (still/yet) are different words with different meanings.
Gib (give) and Schaff (create/make) are different verbs with different meanings.
